key.name: smart-pointer
key.description: While the mode is on: the pointer follows workspace 1 and keeps its place, the workspace swipe works from the secondary screen, the overview keeps the pointer on the primary screen, and pushing the secondary screen's top edge reaches the top bar. Off: GNOME's own pointer behavior.

key.name: smart-windows
key.description: While the mode is on: windows opened on workspace 1 go to the secondary screen, Alt+Tab lists the projected windows on workspace 1 and goes back to it from a private workspace, and leaving workspace 1 takes keyboard focus off projected windows. Off: GNOME's own behavior.

key.name: share-window
key.summary: Share or take back the focused window
key.description: Sends the focused window to the secondary screen, or brings it back to the primary one. Can be changed in the preferences.

key.name: mute-notifications
key.description: Turn notification banners off while the presentation mode is on, and restore them after.

key.name: mirror-border
key.description: Draws a thin red frame around the projected image on workspace 1 and the picture-in-picture. The secondary screen never shows it.

key.name: pip-enabled
key.description: Set from the top bar menu. Shows a small live copy of the secondary screen on private workspaces while the mode is on.

key.name: pip-corner
key.description: The corner it was last dragged to, kept between sessions.

key.name: banners-muted
key.summary: Internal: banners muted by the extension
key.description: Set while the extension holds the notification banners off, so they are restored even after a crash.

key.name: switcher-forced
key.summary: Internal: application switcher restricted by the extension
key.description: Set while the extension holds the switcher on the current workspace, so it is restored even after a crash.
